messages.hero.description: I turn ideas into intuitive, efficient interfaces with personality.
messages.about.intro: Hi, I’m John Baliardo. I’m the front-end lead at SIFAT, where I work on an ERP, primarily with React, and manage the front-end team, including the front-end work of full-stack developers.
messages.about.experience: I’ve been working in development since January 2023 and also take on occasional projects, with experience in ERP systems and other web applications.
messages.about.history: My journey began with graphic design, image editing and website creation, and also included teaching computing and web development. That experience shapes my attention to intuitive interfaces and the people who use them.
messages.about.stack: My main stack is React, JavaScript and Styled-Components/CSS. I’m also familiar with Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, REST APIs and UX/UI. I have full-stack development training and use Node.js on the back end with MongoDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite, as well as Electron.js for desktop applications.
messages.about.values: I value clear communication, objectivity and planning, both when building solutions and collaborating with the team, with a commitment to quality and delivery deadlines.
messages.about.caption: Design meets code.

messages.skills.values: How I work: clear communication, objectivity, planning and problem-solving, in team collaboration and at every stage of delivery.
